==Overview==
'''{{PAGENAME}}'''  is a {{Rarity|Secret}} unit. He can only be obtained by awakening the Sovereign's Staff after sacrificing 3 evolved {{Rarity|Mythical}}. This sacrifices can be from [[Cherub (Overseer)]], [[Lucifer (Demon Emperor)]], [[Bloodcry (Fallen)]], [[Thunder Maid (Servant)]] or [[Crystal Rose (Impact)]].

{{EvolutionTable}}
{{Takedowns|7500}}

==Selling==
Unit sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

==Trivia==
*He and his [[Supreme Being (Sovereign)|evolved form]] are the second {{Rarity|Secret}} units added in the game that are not limited-time. The first units are [[Lulu]] and his [[Lulu (Emperor)|evolved form]].
*It takes a total of 40 rings of each color to get [[Supreme Being (Sovereign)]].
